# Shared Database Schema (PostgreSQL)

**Location:** `/docs/old_implementation/shared/DATABASE_CURRENT.md`

**Scope:** ALL PRODUCTS (Ferd, Hamn, iOS, Android)

**Last Updated:** 2026-04-04  
**Database:** PostgreSQL 15 (Supabase)  
**Generated by:** Claude Code (Supabase schema analysis)

---

## Overview

This document describes the PostgreSQL database schema shared by all FringeIsland products.

**All products connect to the same database:**
- Ferd (web app) — via Supabase JS client
- Hamn (evolved web) — via Supabase JS client  
- iOS app — via Supabase Swift client
- Android app — via Supabase Kotlin client

**Changes to this schema affect all products.**

---

## Tables

### auth.users (Supabase Auth)
**Managed by:** Supabase Auth  
**Purpose:** Authentication records

| Column | Type | Constraints | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|-------------|
| id | uuid | PK | User auth ID |
| email | text | UNIQUE | User email |
| encrypted_password | text | NOT NULL | Hashed password |
| email_confirmed_at | timestamp | | Email verification time |
| created_at | timestamp | DEFAULT now() | Registration time |

**Notes:**
- This is the Supabase Auth table (not directly modified)
- Profile created in public.users via trigger

---

### public.users
**Purpose:** User profiles (public data)

| Column | Type | Constraints | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|-------------|
| id | uuid | PK, FK → auth.users.id | Same as auth ID |
| email | text | UNIQUE, NOT NULL | User email (cached) |
| full_name | text | NOT NULL | Display name |
| avatar_url | text | | Supabase Storage URL |
| is_temporary | boolean | DEFAULT false | Anonymous visitor flag |
| created_at | timestamp | DEFAULT now() | Profile creation |
| updated_at | timestamp | DEFAULT now() | Last update |

**Indexes:**
- `users_email_idx` on email
- `users_is_temporary_idx` on is_temporary (for cleanup jobs)

**RLS Policies:**
- Users can read their own profile
- Users can update their own profile
- Public can read non-temporary profiles

**Created by:** Trigger on auth.users insert  
**See:** [AUTH_SYSTEM.md](./AUTH_SYSTEM.md)

---

### public.groups
**Purpose:** Groups for organizing collective journeys

| Column | Type | Constraints | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|-------------|
| id | uuid | PK, DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4() | Group ID |
| name | text | NOT NULL | Group name |
| description | text | | Group description |
| avatar_url | text | | Group avatar URL |
| privacy | text | CHECK (privacy IN ('public', 'private', 'invite_only')) | Privacy setting |
| is_personal | boolean | DEFAULT false | Personal group flag |
| created_at | timestamp | DEFAULT now() | Creation time |
| updated_at | timestamp | DEFAULT now() | Last update |

**Indexes:**
- `groups_privacy_idx` on privacy
- `groups_is_personal_idx` on is_personal

**RLS Policies:**
- Public groups readable by all
- Private/invite_only readable by members only
- Only Stewards can update group

**See:** [Universal Group Pattern in Ferd ANATOMY.md](/docs/old_products/ferd/architecture/ANATOMY.md#universal-group-pattern)

---

### public.user_roles
**Purpose:** Roles assigned to users within groups

| Column | Type | Constraints | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|-------------|
| id | uuid | PK, DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4() | Role assignment ID |
| user_id | uuid | FK → users.id, NOT NULL | User receiving role |
| group_id | uuid | FK → groups.id, NOT NULL | Group context |
| role_id | uuid | FK → roles.id, NOT NULL | Role definition |
| assigned_at | timestamp | DEFAULT now() | When assigned |

**Unique constraint:** (user_id, group_id) — one role per user per group

**Indexes:**
- `user_roles_user_idx` on user_id
- `user_roles_group_idx` on group_id
- `user_roles_composite_idx` on (user_id, group_id)

**RLS Policies:**
- Users can read their own roles
- Stewards can read all roles in their groups
- Stewards can assign/change roles

**See:** [ADR-F007: Three-Layer Permission Model](/docs/old_products/ferd/architecture/DECISIONS.md#ADR-F007)

---

### public.roles
**Purpose:** Role definitions with permissions

| Column | Type | Constraints | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|-------------|
| id | uuid | PK, DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4() | Role ID |
| group_id | uuid | FK → groups.id, NOT NULL | Group context |
| name | text | NOT NULL | Role name |
| permissions | jsonb | DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb | Permission array |
| is_leader | boolean | DEFAULT false | Steward flag |
| created_at | timestamp | DEFAULT now() | Creation time |

**Unique constraint:** (group_id, name) — unique role names per group

**Indexes:**
- `roles_group_idx` on group_id
- `roles_permissions_idx` GIN on permissions

**RLS Policies:**
- Members can read roles in their groups
- Only Stewards can create/update roles

**Example permissions JSON:**
```json
["groups.create", "groups.update", "groups.invite", "journeys.enroll"]
```

---

### public.journeys
**Purpose:** Journey definitions (content)

| Column | Type | Constraints | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|-------------|
| id | uuid | PK, DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4() | Journey ID |
| title | text | NOT NULL | Journey title |
| description | text | | Journey description |
| thumbnail_url | text | | Thumbnail image URL |
| category | text | | Category (e.g., "self-awareness") |
| difficulty | text | CHECK (difficulty IN ('beginner', 'intermediate', 'advanced')) | Difficulty level |
| estimated_duration_minutes | integer | | Time estimate |
| is_published | boolean | DEFAULT false | Published flag |
| created_at | timestamp | DEFAULT now() | Creation time |
| updated_at | timestamp | DEFAULT now() | Last update |

**Indexes:**
- `journeys_category_idx` on category
- `journeys_difficulty_idx` on difficulty
- `journeys_is_published_idx` on is_published

**RLS Policies:**
- All users can read published journeys
- Only journey authors/admins can update

---

### public.journey_steps
**Purpose:** Steps within journeys

| Column | Type | Constraints | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|-------------|
| id | uuid | PK, DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4() | Step ID |
| journey_id | uuid | FK → journeys.id, NOT NULL | Parent journey |
| sequence_number | integer | NOT NULL | Order in journey |
| title | text | NOT NULL | Step title |
| step_type | text | NOT NULL | Type (reflection, assessment, etc.) |
| config | jsonb | DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb | Step configuration |
| created_at | timestamp | DEFAULT now() | Creation time |

**Unique constraint:** (journey_id, sequence_number)

**Indexes:**
- `journey_steps_journey_idx` on journey_id
- `journey_steps_type_idx` on step_type
- `journey_steps_config_idx` GIN on config

**RLS Policies:**
- Readable by users who can access the journey

---

### public.enrollments
**Purpose:** Track user/group enrollments in journeys

| Column | Type | Constraints | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|-------------|
| id | uuid | PK, DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4() | Enrollment ID |
| user_id | uuid | FK → users.id | Enrolling user (NULL for group) |
| group_id | uuid | FK → groups.id | Enrolling group (NULL for individual) |
| journey_id | uuid | FK → journeys.id, NOT NULL | Journey enrolled in |
| enrolled_at | timestamp | DEFAULT now() | Enrollment time |
| completed_at | timestamp | | Completion time (NULL = in progress) |

**Check constraint:** (user_id IS NOT NULL) OR (group_id IS NOT NULL) — one must be set

**Indexes:**
- `enrollments_user_idx` on user_id
- `enrollments_group_idx` on group_id
- `enrollments_journey_idx` on journey_id

**RLS Policies:**
- Users can read their own enrollments
- Group members can read group enrollments

---

### public.profile_data
**Purpose:** Flexible key-value storage for user data (journey responses, preferences, etc.)

| Column | Type | Constraints | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|-------------|
| id | uuid | PK, DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4() | Record ID |
| user_id | uuid | FK → users.id, NOT NULL | Data owner |
| source | text | NOT NULL | Data source (e.g., "journey_step") |
| key | text | NOT NULL | Data key |
| value | jsonb | NOT NULL | Data value |
| created_at | timestamp | DEFAULT now() | Creation time |
| updated_at | timestamp | DEFAULT now() | Last update |

**Unique constraint:** (user_id, source, key)

**Indexes:**
- `profile_data_user_idx` on user_id
- `profile_data_source_idx` on source
- `profile_data_value_idx` GIN on value

**RLS Policies:**
- Users can only access their own profile_data

**Example usage:**
```sql
-- Journey step response
INSERT INTO profile_data (user_id, source, key, value)
VALUES (
  'user-uuid',
  'journey_step',
  'journey_123_step_1_response',
  '{"answer": "I value authenticity", "timestamp": "2026-04-04T10:30:00Z"}'::jsonb
);
```

**See:** [ADR-F009: Profile Data as Flexible Key-Value Store](/docs/old_products/ferd/architecture/DECISIONS.md#ADR-F009)

## Database Functions

### has_permission(user_uuid, group_uuid, permission_name)
**Purpose:** Check if user has permission in group

**Returns:** boolean

**Usage:**
```sql
SELECT has_permission(
  auth.uid(),
  'group-uuid',
  'journeys.enroll'
);
```

**See:** [RLS_POLICIES.md](./RLS_POLICIES.md)

---

## Triggers

### on_auth_user_created
**Fires:** AFTER INSERT on auth.users  
**Action:** Creates public.users profile and personal group

### on_user_role_changed
**Fires:** AFTER INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE on user_roles  
**Action:** Updates cached permissions
